capacity_selection.design: equal wall budget per arm with early stopping; epoch counts differ by design

cohort.comparability: same eight cases and references as the Burgers lane ROM/FOM diagnosis and the FNO job; accuracy comparable across jobs, timing not

timing.limitation: same-job, same-GPU timings of this lane's arms only; never divide by another job

metric: maximum over the six requested output times of the interior l2 discrepancy divided by the interior l2 norm of the supplied initial field (Burgers lane metric)
limitation: single seed, one mesh, one Gaussian continuum family, bounded wall budget per arm; no speed ratio, no cross-job timing
